subject: a body that is not there is not a field of the answer (internal/shape, #427)
why: The shape axis and the shapes gate both branch on len(Operation.Fields), and a 204 used to make it non-zero: the walk decodes an absent body as nil and writes one entry at the empty path with type "null". MEASURED on 2026-08-24 against the committed shapes/scaleway.json — six operations carried that phantom entry, every one of them a DELETE, so six of the 134 points the axis published were earned by an empty body, and the recording of #427 would have added four more. The number moved upward, which is the direction nobody audits. Both mutations below put a phantom field back, one on the way in and one on the way out, because a file committed before the rule must not go on being believed either.

mutations.expect: a 204 records one field at the empty path again, so every delete this repository ever records counts as an operation whose shape the real cloud proved
mutations.label: an absent body becomes a field again

mutations.expect: a catalogue committed before the rule keeps its phantom fields on load, so the six pre-existing entries go on earning the axis until some unrelated recording happens to touch the same operation
mutations.label: a stale catalogue is believed as written
